GET /api/connectors/conflicts/stories/<s.reason: Reads only the process-local conflict dictionary; the scenario with an existing conflict is measured on the same handler and its database resolution branch.

GET /api/static/default_word_lists.json.reason: Serves a packaged JSON file directly from the filesystem.

GET /api/static/openapi3_1.yaml.reason: Serves a packaged OpenAPI file directly from the filesystem.

GET /static/<path:filename>.reason: Flask's generated static-file handler serves files without entering Core persistence.

POST /api/assess/news-items/fetch.reason: Successful processing waits for the separate simple-web-collector worker; the isolated Core stack has no Worker process, and this route persists no data itself. Its authenticated rejection path is represented by other Assess scenarios.

POST /api/connectors/conflicts/clear.reason: Clears only process-local conflict dictionaries; the handler performs no database access.

PUT /api/bots.reason: The registered collection URL omits the required bot_id argument; Flask raises TypeError before the handler or ORM runs.

PUT /api/connectors/conflicts/stories.reason: The registered URL omits the required story_id argument, so Flask dispatch raises TypeError before entering the handler.

PUT /api/worker/bots.reason: The registered collection URL omits the required bot_id argument; Flask raises TypeError before the handler or ORM runs.

PUT /api/worker/word-lists.reason: The registered collection URL omits the required word_list_id argument; Flask raises TypeError before the handler or ORM runs.
